name: block-wildcard-agent-permissions
description: Blocks agent grants that allow everything: a bare Bash wildcard, a `*` in an allow/alwaysAllow/tools array on the same line, or quoted defaultMode bypassPermissions. Any file is judged. Not caught here: a multi-line array or YAML `- "*"` list, an unquoted defaultMode (agent-permissions-scan warns). Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist broad-agency' same line. Person's commit: honoured. Agent: only if already in HEAD; MCP gateway: never. Agent asks a person. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
